candidate.blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies, printed p.12 / PDF p.16
candidate.educational_objective: Explain the labeled therapeutic purpose of guaifenesin.

options.A: It is an expectorant that helps loosen phlegm and thin bronchial secretions to make coughs more productive.
options.B: It is an opioid that completely suppresses the respiratory drive.
options.C: It permanently stops all mucus production.
options.D: It is an antibiotic used to eradicate viral upper-respiratory infections.

candidate.rationale: OTC guaifenesin labeling identifies the drug as an expectorant and states that it helps loosen phlegm and thin bronchial secretions so coughs are more productive.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Guaifenesin is an expectorant that loosens mucus and thins bronchial secretions.
candidate.source_locator: Drug Facts—Purpose: Expectorant; Uses: loosens phlegm and thins bronchial secretions
candidate.stem: A client with a productive cough asks what guaifenesin is intended to do. Which response is correct?
